ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

fields.spec_version: NXP Application Note AN10833 'MIFARE type identification procedure' Rev. 3.8 (10 January 2023). References ISO/IEC 14443-1/-2/-3/-4 (multiple editions, most-recently 2018 / 2020). Anti-collision and selection are normative per ISO/IEC 14443-3:2018; Block Transmission Protocol per ISO/IEC 14443-4:2018.

spec_lineage_an10833.summary: Correction of Figure 1 (identification decision tree) to the latest version.
Addition of newest generation (MIFARE DESFire EV3 / MIFARE DESFire Light); general restructuring around GetVersion command.
Update for multi-MIFARE implementation and implementation in UICC.
Update for MIFARE implementation in a device.
Update for the new MIFARE Classic with 7-byte UID option.
Third release; supersedes AN MIFARE Interface Platform, Type Identification Procedure, Rev. 1.3, Nov. 2004.

spec_lineage_iso_14443.summary: Defines proximity card physical dimensions, durability.

spec_lineage_iso_14443.version: ISO/IEC 14443-2 (Radio frequency power and signal interface)
spec_lineage_iso_14443.summary: Defines 13.56 MHz carrier, Type A 100% ASK + Modified Miller, Type B 10% ASK + NRZ, load modulation.
Defines REQA/WUPA/ATQA, bit-frame anti-collision, SELECT cascade levels, UID format, SAK, HLTA.
Defines T=CL Block Transmission Protocol — RATS/ATS/PPS, I-Block/R-Block/S-Block, FSCI/FWI/SFGI, CID/NAD.

key_changes.summary: Added the 7-byte UID variant of MIFARE Classic 1K / 4K. Cascade Level 2 required for these variants.
MIFARE Plus EV1 added. SAK 0x10 / 0x11 documented for Plus SL2.

Restructured around GetVersion as the recommended primary identification command for newer chips; documented byte 2 product type table (0xX1 DESFire, 0xX2 Plus, 0xX3 Ultralight, 0xX4 NTAG, 0xX7 NTAG I2C, 0xX8 DESFire Light).

backward_compat_traps.rule: ATQA alone is not sufficient to identify the PICC family. Same ATQA (0x00 0x44) is shared between MIFARE Ultralight, Ultralight C, Ultralight EV1, NTAG21x.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Application that classifies by ATQA only will mis-identify cross-family variants.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SAK alone is not sufficient. SAK = 0x08 is shared between MIFARE Classic 1K, MIFARE Plus SL1 2K/SE, and other Crypto1-compatible PICCs.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Application that selects MIFARE Classic command set by SAK = 0x08 may fail on MIFARE Plus SL1 SE.

backward_compat_traps.rule: AN10833 §1.4 note 4 explicitly states that SAK bit 5 (or other RFU bits) may be re-used for future variants and may change the meaning of all SAK bits.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Hard-coded SAK-by-value classification will silently break on a future MIFARE generation.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Legacy MIFARE Classic 1K / 4K / Ultralight (non-EV1) do not implement GetVersion. PICC returns NAK or error.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host that issues GetVersion as the only ID command will fail on legacy cards; must fall back to ATQA/SAK.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Pre-2010 MIFARE Classic 1K used 4-byte UIDs. Post-2010 MIFARE Classic 1K may use 7-byte UID (Cascade Level 2 required). NUID mapping exists for backward compatibility.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host that assumes 4-byte UID for SAK = 0x08 will overflow buffer on a 7-byte-UID Classic 1K.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Host shall not transmit RATS to a PICC whose SAK b6 = 0. PICC behavior is undefined.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Naive driver that always issues RATS will break on MIFARE Classic / Ultralight / NTAG.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Type B uses REQB / WUPB / ATTRIB / HLTB — entirely distinct from Type A.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Type-A-only PCD will silently miss Type B PICCs (e.g. e-passports).

backward_compat_traps.rule: When UID0 = 0x08, UID is randomised at each Power-on Reset. The visible UID is not the chip's persistent identity.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Application that uses UID as a session identifier will treat the same card as a different card across taps.

fields.version_naming_history_note: Identification doctrine has evolved across AN10833 revisions: through Rev. 3.6 the canonical decision flow was 'ATQA + SAK → family classification'. Rev. 3.7 (2021) introduced GetVersion as the recommended primary identification command for newer chips because (a) SAK bit values may be re-used in future products, (b) ATQA and SAK are coarse and ambiguous, (c) GetVersion deterministically reveals product type + storage size + protocol version. AN10834 ('Software interface ID for MIFARE products') is the companion document used in conjunction with AN10833 for full family disambiguation.
